It's been ages since I was into text adventures. It looks like the IF Archive is still standing, and IFComp is still going. (Not sure whether there's been any "agenda creep" there; haven't looked into it.)

As for where to start, there's lots of great interactive fiction out there, but for a newcomer I'd recommend the Enchanter Trilogy. Classics in their own right, but I'm mainly recommending them because IF games that include a spellcasting system will generally use the Enchanter system, so you might want to experience the original incarnation before playing games that call back to it (such as Lock & Key or The Meteor, The Stone And A Long Glass Of Sherbet.)
